title: HHR News | Embracing Dharawal Aboriginal culture through Sanskrit
text: The SSS is the world’s first school to produce and launch a bilingual CD titled, Yabun Matra (‘In rhythm’ in Dharawal/Sanskrit), a carry along CD in the Dharawal language and in Sanskrit, also containing a songbook. The CD was created to embrace the Australian Indigenous culture with respect and reverence as SSS believes that we have a responsibility to our children and families to maintain a sense of belonging and connection to this land.

title: Students at Jannali Public School sing national anthem in Indigenous language of Dharawal - ABC News
text: May 23, 2016 - "We sing at our assemblies and we do the Sutherland Shire's music festival so we sing with other students," Charlotte, a student in the choir, said. Ms Taylor said the choir and student cohort had been learning and practising the anthem for five years. The school sings the anthem with a similar rhythm and in the same key of Advance Australia Fair, but the verse is one the Dharawal people composed themselves, Ms Taylor said.
